payload.prompt: /patch Issue #1: The committed HEAD of mas-repository.js:1019 uses s.get?.()?.path?.startsWith(folderPath) which over-matches: it includes subfolders and sibling paths with similar prefixes (e.g. /content/dam/offers matches /content/dam/offers-v2/card). The working tree already has the correct fix using exact parent-folder equality (split('/').slice(0,-1).join('/') === folderPath) but this change is not staged or committed. Resolution: Stage and commit the working-tree change in studio/src/mas-repository.js before merging. Severity: tech_debt
